description: Tells whether the mite time tracker is currently running for the key's user and, if so, on which time entry. Returns `running` and, when it runs, `time_entry_id`, the start time `since` and `minutes`, the entry's total so far in minutes. Read-only and takes no input; to look at that entry in full use `mite_get_time_entry`.
name: mite_tracker_status
title: Tracker status
